page_title: MAI 2-0 RBL | Mainz v RB Leipzig 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Jan Siewert decides to make a substitution. Karim Onisiwo will be replaced by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz).
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jae-Sung Lee leaves the pitch and Merveille Papela (Mainz) comes on.
90+2' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robin Zentner intercepts the ball.
90+2' The resulting corner from Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+2' Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to RB Leipzig.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Bastian Dankert shows a yellow card to Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
88' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
85' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) guides an effort goalwards from the edge of the box, but it sails just wide of the left post.
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lukas Klostermann walks off the pitch to be replaced by Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig).
83' Marco Rose prepares a substitution. Xavi Simons is replaced by Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig).
83' We are about to witness a subsitution. Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) for Kevin Kampl.
82' Referee Bastian Dankert points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) goes wild in celebration.
81' Attention! Referee Bastian Dankert straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
80' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
80' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

80' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
79' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) is penalised for holding. Bastian Dankert signals a set piece.

76' 1 - 0 Goal! Karim Onisiwo clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the left side of the goal. Janis Blaswich had no chance of stopping that. 1:0.
75' Tom Krauss (Mainz) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
72' Danny da Costa (Mainz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
69' Tom Krauss (Mainz) commits a rough challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement.
68' The substitution is prepared. Aymen Barkok (Mainz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marco Richter.
68' It is time for a substitution. Tom Krauss (Mainz) is on for Dominik Kohr.
67' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Timo Werner (RB Leipzig) replacing Christoph Baumgartner.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) replaces Lois Openda.
66' What a miss! Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mainz comes to nothing.
59' RB Leipzig work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

59' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Robin Zentner easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner.
58' David Raum (RB Leipzig) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
57' The referee blows his whistle as Marco Richter (Mainz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
56' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' The linesman raises his flag. Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) is adjudged offside.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Bastian Dankert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' Marco Richter (Mainz) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
47' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Janis Blaswich easily deals with the threat.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Marco Richter (Mainz) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Marco Richter (Mainz) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
43' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) is caught offside!
41' Bastian Dankert blows for a foul after Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
40' The resulting corner from Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) is cleared.
40' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Corner kick. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity.
39' The booking goes to Anthony Caci (Mainz).
35' Anthony Caci (Mainz) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Bastian Dankert saw the whole situation.
33' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
28' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
25' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
24' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) was too forceful with his tackle and Bastian Dankert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
23' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
22' Flag goes up against Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
21' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

20' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for RB Leipzig.
16' Substitution. Josuha Guilavogui makes way for Danny da Costa (Mainz).
14' Josuha Guilavogui (Mainz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
13' Josuha Guilavogui (Mainz) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Bastian Dankert no option but to blow his whistle.
12' Anthony Caci (Mainz) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for RB Leipzig.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.

4' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Lois Openda collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence. RB Leipzig force their opponents to concede a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! RB Leipzig will take the kick-off.
Bastian Dankert will referee today's match.
